title: Proper curve invariance over separably closed fields
statement:
Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of separably closed fields [def-pc-separably-closed], and let $\iota:\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be the induced morphism of spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $C$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] whose structure morphism $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and whose underlying topological space has Krull dimension $\dim C\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] (the empty scheme is allowed). Let $C_{k'}=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ be the base change of $C$ along $\iota$ [def-pc-base-change], with projection $\pi:C_{k'}\to C$. Let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf on the small etale site $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], and write $F|_{C_{k'}}=\pi^{-1}F$ for its inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then for every $q\ge0$ the pullback map along $\pi$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]

$$
 \pi^*:H^q(C_{\Et},F)\longrightarrow H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},\pi^{-1}F)
$$

between the etale cohomology groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] is an isomorphism.

external.place: Tag 0A5E (etale-cohomology.tex, lemma-base-change-dim-1-separably-closed), the statement of this node; Tag 03SC is the algebraically closed case it uses

proof.text: The algebraically closed case. By [prop-weil-pbc-algebraically-closed-extension] (Stacks Theorem 03SC, item (7), which the proof of Lemma 0A5E invokes: 'We have seen this for algebraically closed fields in Theorem 03SC'), the following holds: (H) for every extension $K\subseteq K'$ of algebraically closed fields, every scheme $D$ proper over $K$ with $\dim D\le1$, and every torsion abelian sheaf $G$ on $D_{\Et}$, the pullback $H^q(D_{\Et},G)\to H^q((D_{K'})_{\Et},G|_{D_{K'}})$ along the projection $D_{K'}=D\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}K'\to D$ is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$. Statement (H) is exactly the hypothesis of the passage lemma used in the next step (in the Lean, the argument `H` of `bijective_cohomologyMap_of_isSepClosed_of_isAlgClosed`, supplied by `bijective_cohomologyMap_of_isAlgClosed`).

source.place: Lemma 0A5E, proof, first sentence; Theorem 03SC (theorem-vanishing-affine-curves), item (7)

proof.text: Passage to separably closed fields. Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-curve-separably-closed-passage] to the extension $k\subseteq k'$ of separably closed fields, the proper scheme $C$ of dimension $\le1$ over $k$ and the torsion sheaf $F$, with hypothesis (H) of the previous step. It gives that the pullback $\pi^*:H^q(C_{\Et},F)\to H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},\pi^{-1}F)$ along the projection $\pi:C_{k'}\to C$ is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$, which is the claim. (That lemma carries the rest of the proof of Lemma 0A5E: choose algebraic closures $k\subseteq\bar k$, $k'\subseteq\bar k'$ and an embedding $\bar k\to\bar k'$ extending $k\to k'$; $\bar k/k$ and $\bar k'/k'$ are algebraic and purely inseparable because $k,k'$ are separably closed; hence $C_{\bar k}\to C$ and $C_{\bar k'}\to C_{k'}$ are universal homeomorphisms and induce isomorphisms on etale cohomology (Stacks Proposition 03SI (3)); the square of pullback maps between $H^q(C,F)$, $H^q(C_{k'},F|)$, $H^q(C_{\bar k},F|)$, $H^q(C_{\bar k'},F|)$ commutes since both composites are the pullback along the same composite morphism $C_{\bar k'}\to C$, and its bottom row is an isomorphism by (H).)

blueprint_sketch.statement:
Let $k\subseteq k'$ be separably closed fields, $C$ a proper $k$-scheme of
dimension at most one, and $F$ a torsion etale sheaf. Then

$$
H^q(C,F)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(C_{k'},F|)
$$

for every $q$.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
First assume both fields algebraically closed. Apply constructible/primary
reduction. The closed immersion $C_{\mathrm{red}}\to C$ is a universal
homeomorphism, so the explicit site equivalence first replaces $C$ by its
reduction. Then apply dense-open localization, the prime-to-$\ell$ trace
splitting, the
finite-pushforward comparison, and the normalized smooth constant calculation
in that order. Every step commutes with field extension, giving the result.
For separably closed $k\subseteq k'$, apply Lemma
[lemma-weil-pbc-curve-separably-closed-passage] to the algebraically
closed result just proved. Its commutative rectangle identifies the
resulting isomorphism with the specified restriction map. This expands Tags
`03SC` and `0A5E`.
